resources.string:
Run ARM64 Linux / Windows-on-ARM guests under QEMU with hardware KVM.
Needs a CUSTOM KERNEL (CONFIG_KVM=y) that exposes /dev/kvm; Samsung stock disables it.
Flow: Check KVM → set up Debian chroot → install QEMU → run a guest.
GUI guests use a VNC server (connect with a VNC viewer on the phone).
